description: AI connector: a client connects their own Claude or ChatGPT as a custom connector. A remote MCP server (laravel/mcp, Streamable HTTP) at /mcp behind Laravel Passport (OAuth 2.1 for the MCP authorization spec: protected-resource and authorization-server metadata, dynamic client registration, PKCE), scopes content:read and content:write, a consent screen in Czech and English, an audit log of every tool call written through App\Application\Contract\AiConnector\ToolCallAuditLog, a rate limit per token, the global switch AI_CONNECTOR_ENABLED (config ai-connector.enabled, off by default: every route answers 404) and the Filament page "Connected assistants" where users list and revoke their connections. Ships one tool, whoami, and the ConnectorTool base class that the domain tools of later layers extend. Needs laravel/filament (admin login and panel), so it comes after it; it overwrites app/Infrastructure/Models/User.php (adds Passport's HasApiTokens) and bootstrap/providers.php (adds AiConnectorServiceProvider). Passport keys are a deploy secret (PASSPORT_PRIVATE_KEY, PASSPORT_PUBLIC_KEY), never committed. Ships the client guide template docs/client/ai-connector.md.
